articles.summary: Justin Boxford Appointed Chief Executive Officer John D. Idol to Retire Following More than Two Decades of Leadership Robin Freestone to Become Independent Chairman of the Board Transition Effective January 4, 2027 Capri Holdings Limited (NYSE:CPRI), a global fashion luxury group, today announced that Justin Boxford has been named Chief Executive Officer of Capri Holdings and will join the Board of Directors, effective January 4, 2027. His appointment follows John D. Idol’s announcement that he will retire as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer following more than two decades of leadership at Capri. Robin Freestone, Capri Holdings’ current Lead Director, will become Independent Chairman of the Board. To support a smooth transition, Mr. Idol will serve as a senior advisor to Capri Holdings through March 31, 2027.
